ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What part of the plant provides water to the plant?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “Principal Parts of a Vascular Plant,” showing a vascular plant. The part above the ground is labeled “SHOOT,” including flower, leaf blade, petiole, terminal bud, lateral bud, node, internode, and vascular system, etc. The part below the ground is labeled “ROOT,” including primary root, lateral root, root hairs, and root cap. Reasoning: The question asks “Which part of the plant provides water for the plant?” In plants, the roots, especially the root hairs, absorb water from the soil and supply it to other parts of the plant through the vascular system. Therefore the plant part that provides water is root.
